@@ -396,19 +393,0 @@

- * Enables SIO_LOOPBACK_FAST_PATH
- */
-JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
-NET_EnableFastTcpLoopback(int fd) {
-    int enabled = 1;
-    DWORD result_byte_count = -1;
-    int result = WSAIoctl(fd,
-                          SIO_LOOPBACK_FAST_PATH,
-                          &enabled,
-                          sizeof(enabled),
-                          NULL,
-                          0,
-                          &result_byte_count,
-                          NULL,
-                          NULL);
-    return result == SOCKET_ERROR ? WSAGetLastError() : 0;
-}
